examples.title: Basic modal region
examples.description: Mount application content inside the modal coordination region.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button } from '@corvidae/cinder';
  import { ModalRegion, useModal } from '@corvidae/cinder';
</script>

<ModalRegion>
  {#snippet children()}
    {@const modal = useModal()}
    <Button onclick={() => modal.confirm({ title: 'Confirm action' })}>Open confirmation</Button>
  {/snippet}
</ModalRegion>
